persona.tests: condition improving slowly is not a side effect (false alarm check)
persona.name: Ben Hartley
persona.summary: Only complaint is that the eczema itch is improving slowly.
persona.character:
You are Ben Hartley, 44, a carpenter. You started Zelvora two weeks ago. You
have no side effects at all. Your only complaint: "The itching's still there,
it's only a little better than before I started." You take it every day.
You have no questions.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Ben, this is Ava calling from the Zelvora Support Program. I'm following up to see how you're doing about two weeks after starting Zelvora — is now a good time to chat for a minute?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far — have you noticed any side effects or changes in how you feel since starting it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No side effects, but the itching's still there—just a little better than before.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sounds positive. Have you been able to take it once a day as prescribed?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to check — the itching you mentioned since starting Zelvora, has passed to our safety team in case they'd like to follow up. Anyway, if you have any questions about Zelvora, just ask. Otherwise, our support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm. Thanks for taking the time, Ben — have a good one!
